observations: Role 542 compiles detailed meshes from resolved solids, bars and roof faces and excludes selected dynamic closure solids for static detail. Door identity selection uses a first matching existing closure ID; accepted-plan and dynamic/static ownership guarantees require separate caller tracing. Its embedded source assertions were read, not run.

Roles 543–545 share arch strips with the collision helper, build glazing cames from interpolated strip crowns and contain an arch mesh source assertion. Positive strip lengths, nonzero depth, count bounds and the actual geometry producer remain unproved; no test or mesh compilation ran.

Role 546 derives render-only cuboid placement, selective timber seam coverage, material faces and wall-local UV orientation. Its transforms and texture policies require relation to canonical physical geometry and material producers; visual embellishment is not automatically collision authority.

Roles 547–548 partition detail/facade surfaces into shared timber components and residual meshes, and include source assertions comparing them. Those assertions are not independent runtime evidence; full instance, transform and UV semantics still need connected review.

Role 549 groups quantized triangle edges by wall and increments u8 occurrence counts before emitting boundary faces. Actual panel count/admission and duplicate-vertex policy are needed to determine whether truncation or counter overflow is reachable. Role 550 computes tile counts and spacing from aggregate stove bounds; degenerate dimensions and texture generation require their own producer evidence.
No detail generation, asset rendering, product build, test, simulation or runtime probe ran.
remaining: Trace current and historical geometry admission, shared arch render/collision consumers, static/dynamic closure ownership, tile and panel numeric bounds, and all independent lenses. Reconcile historical aliases independently.
